facts.value: The University Computing Center (HRZ) provides students with essential IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Goethe University hotline assists with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-enrollment, subject change, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation, among others.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: International Student Services provides information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, successful studying, careers, and more. They also offer advice and support.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Student Services supports students in social and economic matters. They ensure that students have the necessary infrastructure to successfully study in areas such as educational funding, student housing, canteens, cafeterias, and advisory services.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
